hook.text: Amazon pledged to be carbon-neutral by 2040 and bought 100,000 electric delivery vans.

buildup.text: Last-mile delivery generates 37% of urban transport emissions. Electric vehicles and cargo bikes could change that.

discovery.text: DHL, UPS, and FedEx all have EV programs. Amsterdam requires zero-emission delivery vehicles in its city center by 2025.

twist.text: Carbon offsets let companies claim 'carbon-neutral' delivery while polluting. Buying credits is cheaper than change.

climax.text: True carbon-neutral delivery requires fleet electrification, not offsets. The transition is happening but slowly.

punchline.text: 100K EVs ordered, 2040 pledge. Carbon-neutral delivery is paved with caveats.

quiz.question: Why are carbon offsets considered an imperfect solution for delivery emissions?
options: They let companies claim carbon neutrality while still polluting, avoiding real fleet changes
